# SCP-457 Abilities
This section describes the object's available activated abilities and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General information about the Burning Man" link="Scp457About"]
## "Absorb Fuel" Ability
Activating this ability causes SCP-457 to absorb every combustible item within a radius of 4 tiles. Use it to grow larger and become stronger.
[textlink="More about escape methods" link="Scp457ContainmentBreach"]
## "Ignite Tile" Ability
Activating this ability creates a flame that sets any creature who steps on it alight. Use it to control an area and deal double damage to an opponent.
## "Ignite" Ability
Activating this ability sets every nearby creature on fire, even through windows and walls.
## Dying Flame Mechanic
Over time, your flame will gradually weaken and you will shrink, eventually allowing you to enter and travel through the ventilation system.
This mechanic helps you escape at the start of the round, but it also makes SCP-457 weaker!
## Immunity
The Burning Man is completely immune to every damage type except cold damage.
The only thing that can harm you is water. Watch out for it!
## Absorption Mechanic
By absorbing fuel, you grow larger, increase your combat damage, and gain the ability to destroy barricades and walls while moving.
[textlink="More about states" link="Scp457States"]
## Safety Time Mechanic
During the first 15 minutes of the round, you cannot enter the ventilation system while in your small state.
This mechanic restricts SCP objects at the start of the round, giving personnel time to prepare for the shift.
